title: Settling Basis for the Gallons Released Out of a Refined Fuels Booking
content:
Not every gallon standing undrawn on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is settled. How recently the truck has been to the site, taken with the size of what stands undrawn, decides what is taken off before the settlement is worked out.

**Where 2 or more stops were billed on the account in the three months ending on the handling date and the gallons standing undrawn reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the gallons settled are the gallons standing undrawn less the gallons the most recent stop took, that fill being treated as drawn against the booking.

**Where fewer than 2 stops were billed in that window and the gallons standing undrawn reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the gallons settled are the gallons standing undrawn less the programme's minimum delivery gallons.

**Where the gallons standing undrawn fall under the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons**, the gallons settled are the gallons standing undrawn in full.

| Stops billed in the three months ending on the handling date | Gallons standing undrawn | The gallons settled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The gallons standing undrawn, less the gallons the most recent stop took |
| Fewer than 2 | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The gallons standing undrawn, less the programme's minimum delivery gallons |
| Either way | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The gallons standing undrawn in full |

The gallons settled never fall below nothing on either of the first two lines.

*Hypothetical.* An account on a programme whose minimum pre-buy gallons stand at 1000 and whose minimum delivery is 300 gallons carries 1500.0 gallons standing undrawn. With 3 stops billed in the quarter, the most recent having taken 250.0 gallons, the gallons settled come to 1250.0. With 1 stop billed in the quarter, the gallons settled come to 1200.0. Had only 900.0 gallons stood undrawn, all 900.0 would be settled whichever way the stops fell.
